# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- `@prisma/cli`
- `@prisma/client`
- And if you are adventurous: `@prisma/sdk`

2.13.1-1.5969103e9f5382f2ec7d5a01549da92.name: @prisma/engines
2.13.1-1.5969103e9f5382f2ec7d5a01549da92.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- `@prisma/cli`
- `@prisma/client`
- And if you are adventurous: `@prisma/sdk`

2.13.1-2.fcbc4bb2d306c86c28014f596b1e8c7.name: @prisma/engines
2.13.1-2.fcbc4bb2d306c86c28014f596b1e8c7.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- `@prisma/cli`
- `@prisma/client`
- And if you are adventurous: `@prisma/sdk`

2.16.1-1.8b74ad57aaf2cc6c155f382a18a8e3b.name: @prisma/engines
2.16.1-1.8b74ad57aaf2cc6c155f382a18a8e3b.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- `@prisma/cli`
- `@prisma/client`
- And if you are adventurous: `@prisma/sdk`

2.18.0-7.integration-new-engine-43e73b6d.name: @prisma/engines
2.18.0-7.integration-new-engine-43e73b6d.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- `@prisma/cli`
- `@prisma/client`
- And if you are adventurous: `@prisma/sdk`

2.18.0-23.integration-new-engine-43e73b6.name: @prisma/engines
2.18.0-23.integration-new-engine-43e73b6.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- `@prisma/cli`
- `@prisma/client`
- And if you are adventurous: `@prisma/sdk`

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.19.0-18.integration-napi-tests-0bb4e37.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.23.0-15.query-engine-unify-aggregation.name: @prisma/engines
2.23.0-15.query-engine-unify-aggregation.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.23.0-23.query-engine-unify-aggregation.name: @prisma/engines
2.23.0-23.query-engine-unify-aggregation.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.23.0-30.query-engine-unify-aggregation.name: @prisma/engines
2.23.0-30.query-engine-unify-aggregation.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.25.0-7.unreverse-b2b024adf6ccc47d0c50d.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.26.0-1.unreverse-f085fab555584caafc607.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.26.0-21.migration-engine-migrate-actio.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.26.0-22.migration-engine-migrate-actio.name: @prisma/engines
2.26.0-22.migration-engine-migrate-actio.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.27.0-44.query-engine-hyper-4ff0e142dfe.name: @prisma/engines
2.27.0-44.query-engine-hyper-4ff0e142dfe.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.29.0-20.enabling-node-api-6287731616bd.name: @prisma/engines
2.29.0-20.enabling-node-api-6287731616bd.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.31.0-9.query-engine-rework-json-nullab.name: @prisma/engines
2.31.0-9.query-engine-rework-json-nullab.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

2.31.0-25.node-api-threadsafe-unref-1ca2.name: @prisma/engines
2.31.0-25.node-api-threadsafe-unref-1ca2.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.2.1-1.b71d8cb16c4ddc7e3e9821f42fd09b0f.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.5.0-18.make-count-non-nullable-121a035.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.6.0-20.query-engine-in-filter-03d89ba0.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.7.0-11.qe-napi-2-7d9243c73ade811196e36.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.8.0-15.qe-napi-2-aea7eb19eba5e9530c6fd.name: @prisma/engines
3.8.0-15.qe-napi-2-aea7eb19eba5e9530c6fd.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.8.0-33.migration-engine-json-rpc-print.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.8.0-35.migration-engine-json-rpc-print.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.9.0-2.migration-engine-json-rpc-print-.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.10.0-18.node-logging-layer-69048c1df2f.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.10.0-48.query-engine-composite-basic-a.name: @prisma/engines
3.10.0-48.query-engine-composite-basic-a.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.11.0-30.test-mobc-fix-ca9fb922c8fd66aa.name: @prisma/engines
3.11.0-30.test-mobc-fix-ca9fb922c8fd66aa.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.11.0-35.logging-dispatch-20f8df70f3d1d.name: @prisma/engines
3.11.0-35.logging-dispatch-20f8df70f3d1d.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.12.0-11.query-engine-mongodb-filter-re.name: @prisma/engines
3.12.0-11.query-engine-mongodb-filter-re.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.13.0-5.chore-napi-rs-v2-e87225b9b65cc8.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.13.0-13.feat-11511-5e9df6388d336731e39.name: @prisma/engines
3.13.0-13.feat-11511-5e9df6388d336731e39.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.14.0-13.fix-query-raw-input-coercion-9.name: @prisma/engines
3.14.0-13.fix-query-raw-input-coercion-9.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.15.0-14.add-global-labels-binary-c65dc.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.15.0-17.add-global-labels-binary-e5351.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.15.1-1.461d6a05159055555eb7dfb337c9fb2.name: @prisma/engines
3.15.1-1.461d6a05159055555eb7dfb337c9fb2.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.16.0-12.query-engine-nodeapi-experimen.name: @prisma/engines
3.16.0-12.query-engine-nodeapi-experimen.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
It has a one to one mapping to the engine releases in its version.
In the postinall hook of this package, all engines available for the current platform are downloaded from the Prisma CDN.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

3.16.0-28.p4-scalar-list-defaults-b10480.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.

4.1.0-dev.12.readme:
# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
The postinstall hook of this package downloads all engines available for the current platform are from the Prisma CDN.
The engines to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
The postinstall hook of this package downloads all engines available for the current platform are from the Prisma CDN.
The engines to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
The postinstall hook of this package downloads all engines available for the current platform are from the Prisma CDN.
The engines to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
The postinstall hook of this package downloads all engines available for the current platform are from the Prisma CDN.
The engines to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all engines available for the current platform are from the Prisma CDN.
The engines to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

This package ships the Prisma Engines, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format.
The postinstall hook of this package downloads all engines available for the current platform are from the Prisma CDN.
The engines to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine, Migration Engine, Introspection Engine and Prisma Format from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine and the Migration Engine from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine and the Migration Engine from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine and the Migration Engine from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine and the Migration Engine from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine and the Migration Engine from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)

# `@prisma/engines`

⚠️ **Warning**: This package is intended for Prisma's internal use.
Its release cycle does not follow SemVer, which means we might release breaking changes (change APIs, remove functionality) without any prior warning.

The postinstall hook of this package downloads all Prisma engines available for the current platform, namely the Query Engine and the Migration Engine from the Prisma CDN.

The engines version to be downloaded are directly determined by the version of its `@prisma/engines-version` dependency.

You should probably not use this package directly, but instead use one of these:

- [`prisma` CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/prisma)
- [`@prisma/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@prisma/client)
